name: atendimento-mvp
description: MVP de Atendimentos Operacionais com NestJS e Angular PO-UI

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d db legacy_db
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.seed:backend: cd backend && npx prisma db seed --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.bootstrap:local: npm run db:up && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run seed:backend
